{"explanation": "The invoice was held because its line items do not add up to the stated total: subtotal, tax, and freight come to 18008.79, but the invoice total shows 21430.46, a difference of 3421.67. Please check the invoice's line amounts, tax, and freight against the total, and confirm the PO reference PO-ALINFLATED matches the order you intended.", "email_subject": "Request for corrected invoice RA-81392", "email_body": "Dear Blouberg Industrial Supply CC team,

Thank you for invoice RA-81392 dated 2025-01-16. During our review, we found that the subtotal plus tax and freight comes to 18008.79 ZAR, while the invoice total shows 21430.46 ZAR, a difference of 3421.67 ZAR. We also noted that the PO reference on the invoice is PO-ALINFLATED.

Could you please review the invoice and send us either a corrected invoice or written confirmation of the correct total and PO number? We will be able to continue processing once we receive this.

Thank you for your help.

Kind regards,
Accounts Payable"}
